statements.impact_statement: Risk accepted, see https://github.com/streamingfast/sf-analytics/issues/207. openssl in Debian 13 (distroless base) has no fix yet. The Debian libssl3 is never loaded: the node binary statically bundles its own OpenSSL and has no libssl/libcrypto dependency. PEM_X509_INFO_read_bio_ex use-after-free needs an application passing a pre-filled stack; the Next.js server never calls it. Re-check by 2026-12-24, remove when Debian ships the fixed openssl
